name: recruitee-mcp
description: Recruitee (jobs): search, apply. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_recruitee_careers_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_RECRUITEE_CAREERS_TOKEN
platform_mcp_recruitee_careers_token.description: Careers Site API token generated by a Recruitee user of the company, sent as `X-Careers-Sites-Token`; 'Deadline for introducing the token to calls is 10 February 2027. Calls without the authorization header will return the 401 Unauthorized error'.

platform_mcp_recruitee_company_subdomain.title: PLATFORM_MCP_RECRUITEE_COMPANY_SUBDOMAIN
platform_mcp_recruitee_company_subdomain.description: The company's Recruitee careers-site subdomain, e.g. 'recruiteedemo' in https://recruiteedemo.recruitee.com.

platform_mcp_recruitee_applicant_name.title: PLATFORM_MCP_RECRUITEE_APPLICANT_NAME
platform_mcp_recruitee_applicant_name.description: Candidate full name sent as candidate.name by apply (required by Recruitee for applications).

platform_mcp_recruitee_applicant_email.title: PLATFORM_MCP_RECRUITEE_APPLICANT_EMAIL
platform_mcp_recruitee_applicant_email.description: Candidate e-mail sent as candidate.email by apply (required by Recruitee for applications).

platform_mcp_recruitee_applicant_phone.title: PLATFORM_MCP_RECRUITEE_APPLICANT_PHONE
platform_mcp_recruitee_applicant_phone.description: Candidate phone sent as candidate.phone by apply (required unless the offer's form makes it optional).

tools.name: search
tools.description: Careers Site API for ONE company (config company_subdomain): GET https://{company}.recruitee.com/api/offers/ 'Returns a collection of published company jobs'. Its only filters are department and tag names, so query/location/page/limit are not sent: every published offer comes back in one response — filter client-side and do not request further pages. id is the offer slug (apply takes it); requirements, highlight, remote/on_site/hybrid, locations[], employment_type_code, salary {min, max, period, currency} (amounts are strings), options_cv/options_phone/options_cover_letter and open_questions are in raw.

tools.name: apply
tools.description: Submits a REAL application to the employer in the configured candidate's name (applicant_name/applicant_email/applicant_phone config): POST /api/offers/{offer_slug}/candidates with JSON {candidate: {name, email, phone, cover_letter, remote_cv_url}} — 'creating a candidate via this API is like a candidate applying for a job and it will trigger all actions connected with it (like sending an application confirmation email)'. id is the offer slug from search; resume_url must be a publicly downloadable CV link ('Link to file saved on some external website'). Name and email are always required; phone and CV are required unless the offer's form turns them off (see options_phone/options_cv on the offer). Screening-question answers (open_questions) cannot be sent by this tool, so offers with required questions will be refused.
